A '''Defensus Solar Security Officer''' was a law enforcement officer working for [[Defensus Solar]] aboard [[Zirtran's Anchor/Legends|''Zirtran's Anchor'']]. Defensus Solar Security Officers were popularly referred to as '''DeeSos'''.<ref name="Zirtran's Anchor (article)">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref>
